# Vlad Koert

> Digital creative and photographer based in Brussels, Belgium. Five years across graphic design, web design, video/motion and 3D, plus fifteen years of photography. Available for freelance and full-time work.

Vlad Koert helps brands and studios turn dense, complex subjects into clear, visual, and felt work — combining a photographer's eye for light and composition with a multidisciplinary digital-creative practice (graphic design, brand identity, web design, video, motion, 3D, and AI-assisted creative workflows).

## Site map

- [Home](https://vladkoert.com/): overview, about, and selected work
- [Work](https://vladkoert.com/work): full list of projects across branding, web, photography, video and 3D
- [Contact](https://vladkoert.com/contact): get in touch about freelance or full-time work

## Selected projects

- [Excelsior!](https://vladkoert.com/work/excelsior) — logo refresh and brand system for a Brussels beer bar
- [the hive](https://vladkoert.com/work/the-hive) — visual identity for a coworking space
- [Nuvo](https://vladkoert.com/work/nuvo) — event poster and social content system for a Kinshasa nightclub
- [Laboriver](https://vladkoert.com/work/laboriver) — card system for an analogue photo lab in Brussels
- [3D Studies](https://vladkoert.com/work/3d-studies) — personal 3D render studies
- [Wandering Through The Night](https://vladkoert.com/work/wandering-through-the-night) — long-running night photography series
- [Kæshy](https://vladkoert.com/work/kaeshy) — visual identity for a streetwear brand
- [Portraits](https://vladkoert.com/work/portraits) — ongoing environmental portrait photography
- [EON Yama](https://vladkoert.com/work/eon-yama) — music visuals for the artist EON Yama
- [Bball in the sky](https://vladkoert.com/work/bball-in-the-sky) — winning logo contest entry, later animated
- [Wrestling](https://vladkoert.com/work/wrestling) — ringside event photography

## Facts

- Based in Brussels, Belgium
- 5+ years as a digital creative; 15+ years of photography
- Services: graphic design & brand identity, web design & front-end, photography & art direction, video/motion & 3D, AI-assisted creative workflows
- Status: available for freelance and full-time opportunities
